newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 107.5 Feb 28 wk.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 107.5 Feb 28 wk.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly future inflation gauge (FIG) slipped to 107.5 in the week ended February 28 from a revised 107.6 the prior week, ECRI said.

The growth rates of real estate loans fell and the yield spread between 10-year and three-month Treasuries widened, but were mostly offset by a rise in material prices and a drop in the insured unemployment rate, ECRI said.
"The (FIG) increase (over the past few months) has so far been gradual and insufficient to indicate that a cyclical upturn in inflation is around the corner," it said.
